reality: SSC CGL is the main route for Inspector posts. IRS via UPSC CSE.
Income Tax Inspector: field work (raids, surveys) + office work (assessment).
Customs Inspector: airport/seaport/land border duty. Irregular hours.
Tax Assistant: desk job, data entry, processing returns. Less field work.
Physical standards strict for Customs. Color blindness disqualifies.
Salary: Inspector ~₹44,900 (Level 7) + DA + HRA. IRS Officer ~₹56,100 (Level 10).

syllabus.exam: SSC CGL — Income Tax Inspector / CBIC Inspector
syllabus.pattern: Entry to Inspector posts in CBDT and CBIC is through SSC CGL. Tier 1: 100 questions, 200 marks, 60 minutes, negative 0.50. Tier 2: section-wise papers with negative marking; the syllabus is the CGL syllabus.

topics.items: General Intelligence & Reasoning, General Awareness, Quantitative Aptitude, English Comprehension
Mathematical abilities, reasoning and general intelligence, English language and comprehension, general awareness, computer proficiency, and the descriptive paper where applicable
CBIC Inspector posts add a physical standard test; CBDT posts do not. Check the CGL notice for the post you are opting

syllabus.books: SSC CGL Guide (Amazon) · Flipkart

syllabus.pattern: State PSC or state tax board examination with general studies, law and accounts papers. The exact subjects and marks are set by each state public service commission.

topics.items: Polity, economy, history, geography, current affairs of the state and the country
State VAT / GST law, registration, input tax credit, returns, assessment, appeals and penalties
Basic accounting, bookkeeping, auditing and commercial arithmetic

syllabus.books: SSC CGL Tier 2 Guide (Amazon)

syllabus.pattern: Departmental promotion examinations for existing inspectors and superintendents, conducted by the CBIC and state tax departments on the law in force.

topics.items: CGST Act and rules, IGST, customs law, central excise legacy provisions, demand and recovery, refunds, appeals
Assessment, audit, search and seizure, prosecution, and departmental procedure manuals

faq.q: What is the difference between Income Tax Inspector and Customs Inspector?
faq.a: Income Tax Inspector: assesses income tax, conducts raids/surveys, office-based. Customs Inspector: customs clearance at ports/airports, anti-smuggling. Different departments (CBDT vs CBIC).

faq.q: Can a commerce graduate apply for revenue jobs?
faq.a: Yes. Any graduate can apply for Tax Assistant and Inspector posts via SSC CGL. IRS via UPSC CSE. Commerce background helps but is not mandatory.

faq.q: What is the age limit for revenue jobs?
faq.a: Tax Assistant: 18-27 years. Inspector: 18-30 years. IRS: 21-32 years. Age relaxations for SC/ST/OBC/PwD.

faq.q: Is there negative marking in revenue exams?
faq.a: Yes. SSC CGL Tier 1: 0.50. Tier 2: 0.25. No negative marking in typing/skill tests.

faq.q: How many vacancies are there in revenue?
faq.a: Income Tax: 500-1000 (Inspector) annually. Customs: 300-500. Total revenue vacancies exceed 3000 per year via SSC CGL.

faq.q: Where do I find official revenue notifications?
faq.a: ssc.gov.in (SSC CGL), upsc.gov.in (IRS). SarkariJobs+ links the official notification on every listing.

prepPlan.phase: If you are entering through CGL
prepPlan.what: Prepare the SSC CGL syllabus first — reasoning, quantitative aptitude, English and general awareness. Revenue posts are allotted on the CGL merit and preference form, so the CGL score decides whether you get a tax post at all.
Arithmetic, advance maths and reasoning at CGL level. Revenue inspector posts are cut-off driven, and Tier 2 maths carries the most marks.
English is the fastest section to improve. Add a daily current-affairs slot and a basic economy glossary — budget, GST, direct tax, customs terms appear in general awareness.
If you are targeting a state commercial tax officer post, read the state VAT/GST Act and the state PSC syllabus. Add basic accountancy; most candidates lose marks there, not in general studies.
Weekly CGL mocks with the 0.50 negative-marking rule, and for CBIC posts start the physical standard practice early — it is qualifying and non-negotiable.
